The company's market share climbed to 7.3%, thanks to heightened demand for scooters and VIDA electric vehicle sales. With plans for new premium motorcycle launches and an expansion of EV production, Hero anticipates a revival in international markets, projecting growth in exports for the latter half of FY27.
